## 3. THE PAVEMENT, THE CRATE, AND THE FIRST TIME SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH FOUND OUT THAT A THING HAD AN ORIGIN NOBODY COULD NAME — CHAPTER 0175

**ON SATURDAY THE EIGHTEENTH OF JULY 2015 TWO TRESTLE TABLES AND A BOX OF WATER BOTTLES WERE ON A PAVEMENT ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE MARKET, PUT OUT AT ABOUT ELEVEN AND BROUGHT IN AT ABOUT FIVE SINCE ABOUT THE THIRD OF JULY, WITH NOTHING WRITTEN ON THEM, AND A CRATE WAS BESIDE THEM THAT NOBODY BROUGHT.**

- **THE CRATE ARRIVED ON THE FRIDAY OF THE TENTH OF JULY AND IS NOT ANYBODY'S.** It came out of the back of the shop because the man from the cold store picked an empty out of the box in front of people and had nowhere to put it but the crate that was already behind the shop for onions. **THE CRATE IS NOT A DECISION, IT IS A CONSEQUENCE, AND THE TWO ARE NOT THE SAME THING AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN TELL YOU THE DIFFERENCE.**
- **BY THE EIGHTEENTH THE CRATE HAD A PLACE.** It stands against the leg of the near table and not beside the bin, and there were four empties standing up in it and two fulls at about half past eleven, and at about five the man from the cold store carried four empties and two fulls out to a sack and took the crate in with them. **THIS PARAGRAPH PREVIOUSLY SAID *FOUR EMPTIES ... AND SIX AT ABOUT FIVE*, WHICH NORMALISED A DRAFTING FAULT INSTEAD OF RECORDING IT: line 111 OF CHAPTER 0175 READ *FOUR EMPTIES AND TWO EMPTIES INTO A SACK*, WHICH CONTRADICTS LINE 27 OF THE SAME CHAPTER, WHERE THE CRATE HAS TWO FULL BOTTLES IN IT AND FOUR EMPTIES STANDING UP. THE SECOND IS *FULLS* AND IS NOW *FULLS*.** **THE TABLES AND THE BOX CANNOT BE POINTED AT. A CRATE CAN. A CRATE IS A CONTAINER, AND A CONTAINER IS A PLACE A THING CAN BE PUT, AND A PLACE A THING CAN BE PUT IS THE FIRST HALF OF AN ARRANGEMENT, AND THE MAN WHO FILLS IT IS A MAN.** Four people in this borough know the crate is there and three of them work at that shop.
- **A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-EIGHT WHO HAS SOLD FRUIT OFF THAT FRONTAGE ON SATURDAYS FOR NINE YEARS SAID, UNASKED, TO THE PAVEMENT AND NOT TO ANYBODY, THAT HE DOES NOT KNOW WHO PUT IT THERE AND THAT IT WAS THERE AT HALF PAST NINE WHEN HE CAME WITH HIS VAN, AND THAT NOBODY IS GOING TO BE ABLE TO TELL HIM EITHER, AND WHY: THE SECOND ONE OF US SAYS THE NAME OF THE THING OUT LOUD, IT IS A THING TWO PEOPLE KNOW ABOUT, AND BY THE FOLLOWING JUNE THERE IS A FORM WITH A NAME BOX ON IT AND THE FORM IS WORSE THAN THE TABLE.**
- **THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS FOUND OUT THAT A THING IN IT HAS AN ORIGIN NOBODY CAN NAME: THE ORIGIN IS NOT A DOCUMENT AND NOT A PERSON ANYBODY CAN BE ASKED ABOUT. HE ASKED NOBODY. THE MAN OF THIRTY-TWO STOOD AT THE END OF THAT FRONTAGE FOR ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN HOUR AND ASKED NOBODY ANYTHING.**
- **NOBODY COUNTS THE EMPTIES AND THE CHAPTER SAYS WHY: four empties in a crate is a number of bottles and is not the same number, and a number of people with nobody's name on it is a list of people, and this borough has already got two of those and has never once wanted a third.** He has not been thanked and nobody refused to be thanked and he is not going to be recognised. The shade on that pavement moves about four feet every two hours and everybody who puts a table in the shade knows it and nobody has written down how it works.

## 4. THE HINGE: A MONTH-OLD SHEET, A PROPOSAL, FOUR PEOPLE WHO WERE ALL RIGHT, AND A SENTENCE THAT IS GOING TO COST SOMEBODY — CHAPTER 0176

**ON SUNDAY THE NINETEENTH OF JULY 2015 THE SHEET OF THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE WAS A MONTH OLD, AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-THREE STOOD UP IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP IN TIDEGLASS AND PROPOSED THAT IT BE PRINTED AGAIN AND PUT ROUND EVERY BUILDING IN THE BOROUGH ON A FRIDAY.**

- **FOUR PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS RIGHT ABOUT SOMETHING.** The woman of about forty-three was right that a correct sheet is the cheapest thing anybody has done on those four streets in nine months and that a document with a date on it is the only repeatable act this borough owns. The man of about sixty-four, a duty clerk who is the person a printing run has to go through, was right that a sheet is not a document, that a document puts a name in a box, and that nobody is required to keep to three words printed under a heading. The woman of about fifty-six, who has the keys, was right that the June sheet reached nine buildings because it went round in a tray with nine other things in it, two of them a lunch menu and a leaflet about a closure, and that sending trays round on purpose takes that away and puts a schedule in its place, and a schedule is a person.
- **THE SECOND PRINT OF THAT SHELL OF THE SECOND COPY IS NOT A FINDING AND IS NOT STAGED AGAIN: THE JUNE SHEET WAS NOT WITHDRAWN, THE SECOND SHEET WITH ITS EMPTY COLUMN WAS NOT WITHDRAWN, NEITHER WAS ANNOTATED, AND NOBODY IN ANY OF THE NINE BUILDINGS KNOWS THERE ARE TWO OF THEM.** The man of sixty-four took two hundred June sheets out of a cupboard on the tenth of July and nobody in that building knows to this day that he did.
- **THE PROPOSAL WAS NOT MINUTED, NOT REFUSED AND NOT AGREED, AND NOBODY WAS PUT TO ANYBODY, AND A MAN STANDING UP IN A ROOM WITH AN IDEA IS NOT A REQUEST.** He may not chair anything and there is no chair of that body.
- **AND ONE SENTENCE WENT OUT OF THAT ROOM, AND IT WAS NOT SAID BY THE PERSON WHO MADE THE PROPOSAL.** The woman of fifty-six said at the door, to the man of sixty-four, that it is the cheapest thing anybody has done on those four streets this year, that it has got no name on it, and that is the whole of why it works, and the day somebody asks her why it works she will have to say who told her and she is not going to; and she told him that so that he could be the person she does not tell. **IN ABOUT A YEAR SOMEBODY IS GOING TO WANT TO KNOW WHERE THAT SENTENCE CAME FROM, AND THREE PEOPLE IN THAT ROOM COULD ANSWER IT, AND WHICH OF THEM WILL IS NOT GOING TO BE WRITTEN DOWN EITHER. THE READER IS NOT TOLD.**

## 5. A CORRECT REQUEST, GRANTED QUICKLY, WITH NO PAPER ON IT, AND THE BILL FOUR MILES AWAY — CHAPTER 0177

**ON TUESDAY THE TWENTY-FIRST OF JULY 2015 A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-ONE, WHO HAS HAD A PITCH AT A MARKET FOR ABOUT TWENTY-TWO YEARS AND IS ON SITE AT FIVE, ASKED A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FIVE IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A BUILDER'S MERCHANT FOR A DOOR AND A TAP, AND HE SAID YES IN ABOUT THREE SENTENCES AND LEFT A PADLOCK UNLATCHED.**

- **SHE HAD ASKED FOR A TAP TWICE THIS YEAR AND WAS POLITE BOTH TIMES AND STOPPED ASKING. SHE ASKED FOR A LOO. HE SAID: THERE IS A WELFARE HUT IN THE YARD ON THIS COMPOUND, IT HAS BEEN LOCKED SINCE JUNE, IT IS NOT OURS, IT IS STANDING HERE UNTIL THE NEXT JOB, THERE IS A UNIT ON THE WATER INSIDE IT AND A TAP ON THE WALL OUTSIDE IT, PUT YOUR PEOPLE ON THE CORNER BY THE GATE AND NOT BY THE OFFICE, BE OFF BY HALF SIX BECAUSE THE GATE IS SHUT BY A MAN WHO WILL NOT BE NICE ABOUT IT, AND I WILL LEAVE THE PADLOCK UNLATCHED, AND THAT IS NOT PERMISSION, THAT IS A MAN WHO HAS NOT LOCKED IT.** No paper, no reference, nothing written down, and nobody in that room asked him to.
- **THE UNIT CAME FROM A HIRE YARD OVER THE BOUNDARY. IT WAS BOOKED INTO THAT YARD ON FRIDAY THE SEVENTEENTH AT ABOUT TEN PAST FOUR BY A MAN WITH A JOB AND A COMPOUND AND A PADLOCK. BEFORE THAT IT WAS PENCILLED IN ON A BOARD FOR A MARKET HALL FOUR MILES AWAY, IN ANOTHER BOROUGH, AND THAT PENCILLED BOOKING WAS RELEASED ON THE FRIDAY AFTERNOON BY THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THAT BOARD, BECAUSE ONE FIRM BOOKING AND ONE PENCILLED ONE IS A VERY ORDINARY FRIDAY.**
- **THE COST FELL ON A WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-THREE WHO HAS THE KEYS TO THAT HALL AND CLEANS IT HERSELF. SHE HAS BEEN TELLING SIX TRADERS A DAY FOR SIX WEEKS THAT THERE IS A TOILET AT THE LEISURE CENTRE, AND SHE IS TELLING THEM THE TRUTH, AND SHE DOES NOT KNOW THAT THE UNIT THAT WOULD HAVE GONE INTO HER TRADERS' BLOCK WAS RELEASED ON A FRIDAY EVENING. NOBODY IS GOING TO TELL HER.**
- **AND THE REASON NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS GOING TO GO AND LOOK IS NOT DISCRETION AND NOT KINDNESS AND IT DID NOT OCCUR TO ANYBODY AS A DECISION. IT IS THAT SHE IS WRITTEN DOWN. She is on a contract with her name on it and an address for it, and the day anybody rings that contract to ask whether a unit was released on the Friday, she stops being a woman who cleans a hall and becomes a person who has been asked about, and she will have to remember, and she will have to remember it in front of somebody who has come a long way to find out. A PERSON WHO IS WRITTEN DOWN TO DO A THING IS A PERSON SOMEBODY CAN RING ABOUT IT.**
- **HE COULD HAVE FOUND OUT IN FOUR WAYS IN AN HOUR AND USED NONE, AND THE REASON IS ABOUT HIM AND NOT ABOUT THE MARKET: he is not on anything, he has no department, and there is no building he could walk into on the Tuesday and ask in a way that would go anywhere. The whole of his standing here is that he can say a true thing out loud to a person in a room, and a true thing said out loud in a room goes into the room, and that is all it does, and it has never once come back with an answer.**
- **NOBODY WAS HURT AND NOBODY DIED AND NOTHING WAS HELPED. A THING WAS MOVED FROM A PLACE NOBODY WAS LOOKING AT TO A PLACE NOBODY IS LOOKING AT, FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AND A GATE IS NOT IN THAT CHAPTER AND THE FIGURE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS WAS NOT USED FOR IT, AND THE CHAPTER SAYS PLAINLY THAT THIS IS THE CHEAPEST OUTCOME ANYWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH AND THAT IT IS ALSO THE REASON THERE IS NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH ANYBODY CAN POINT AT.** He is not Colin Wharton, whose name was not said to anybody in this batch, and no Weir resident is described in anything.

## 6. A THING CARRIED IN DAYLIGHT, AND A THANK-YOU FOR SOMETHING ELSE — CHAPTER 0178

**ON WEDNESDAY THE TWENTY-TWOUND OF JULY 2015 A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-NINE, WHO LIVES ON THE SECOND FLOOR OF A BLOCK OFF A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS, TOOK TWO BAGS OFF A WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-SEVEN ON THE BOTTOM OF THAT STAIRCELL AND CARRIED FOUR UP FOUR FLOORS AT HALF PAST THREE IN THE AFTERNOON.**

- **SHE CAME IN WITH FOUR FULL BAGS AND WAS GOING TO DO IT IN FOUR GOES. HE WENT DOWN PAST HER, CAME BACK UP WITH HIS HANDS OUT, TOOK TWO BAGS OFF HER WITHOUT ASKING, AND SAID *IT IS FOUR FLOORS AND A BAG EACH, I HAVE TO GO DOWN ANYWAY.* THERE IS NO ARRANGEMENT, NO ROTA, NO LIST AND NO PERSON HE CANNOT SAY NO TO, AND NOBODY ASKED HIM TO.**
- **A MAN WITH A PUSHCHIC WAITED ON THE HALF-LANDING, TWO PEOPLE AT THE BOTTOM STEPPED ASIDE, A WOMAN AT A WINDOW LOOKED DOWN AND LOOKED AWAY. NOBODY OFFERED AND NOBODY CAME UP BEHIND HIM WITH A THIRD BAG. HE PUT THE FOUR BAGS ON HER LANDING FLOOR AND SAID HE WAS GOING DOWN AND WOULD BE TWO MINUTES AHEAD OF HER, AND SHE SAID SHE WOULD COME IN A MINUTE, AND HE SAID DO NOT BOTHER.**
- **THIS IS THE SECOND TIME IN A MONTH THIS BOROUGH HAS SEEN THE SHAPE AND THE SHAPE IS THE SAME AND THE PERSON IS DIFFERENT AND THE STREET IS DIFFERENT AND THE WEEK IS DIFFERENT, AND WHETHER IT IS THE SAME THING IS NOT SAID. On the sixteenth a man of sixty-three carried four buckets up a flight of steps in front of about nine people and nobody had asked him to. The one word that differs is that a bag of shopping is the cheapest thing anybody in this borough has ever been asked to carry, and the reason it costs nothing is that it is worth nothing, and that is the entire mechanism.**
- **AND THEN THE WOMAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-SEVEN SAID THANK YOU, AND IT WAS NOT FOR THE BAGS. She thanked him for telling her in June that the water would not be off on the Wednesday, on the Monday, in a corridor, when she could still have done something about it, and she said nobody has ever asked you for that and nobody is going to. HE SAID IT WAS ON A BOARD. SHE SAID IT WAS ON A BOARD IN A CORROR AND YOU READ IT AND YOU TOLD ME. THE THANKING WENT TO THE CORRIDOR AND THE CARRYING WAS STANDING RIGHT THERE AND NOBODY PUT THEM TOGETHER, INCLUDING THE MAN WHO WAS CARRYING.**
- **THE CARRYING GOES ON BEING A THING THAT HAPPENED AND THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH TO PUT IT, AND IN ABOUT A YEAR SHE MAY TELL IT AS A STORY ABOUT A MAN WHO CARRIED HER SHOPPING, AND BY THEN THE TWO WILL HAVE BEEN IN THE SAME STORY SO LONG THAT THE PERSON TELLING IT WILL NOT KNOW WHICH ONE OF THEM WAS THE FAVOUR.**
- **AND THE COST FELL ON THE PERSON WHO WAS NOT BEING CARRIED ANYTHING, AND THAT PERSON WAS IN THE ROOM.** A man of thirty-two was on that half-landing going down with nothing in his hands and he carried nothing and he is the only person in that block who knows both halves of it. If anything is ever asked about that stairwell the person anybody would ask is him, and not because he is in charge of anything, and he has never in his life been the person anybody brings an answer back to.
- **HE HAD A WORD FOR IT IN JUNE AND IT IS NOT HIS.** It belongs to a person of nineteen who is owed nothing and is owed it and got it for nothing, and she had it on a footbridge in May about something entirely different, and he did not say it then and he is not going to say it here. **AND THERE WAS NO OTHER WORD. HE LOOKED FOR ONE ON THAT HALF-LANDING FOR ABOUT AS LONG AS IT TAKES TO GO DOWN A FLIGHT OF STAIRS AND THERE WAS NOT ONE, AND NOT HAVING ONE IS NOT BETTER AND IT IS NOT A PRINCIPLE AND IT DID NOT OCCUR TO HIM AS ANYTHING AT ALL. IT IS A TUESDAY, AND THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A WORD THAT STOPS A THING HAPPENING AND NO WORD AT ALL IS NOT A MORAL POSITION. IT IS ONLY THAT THE BAG GOT CARRIED EITHER WAY.**

## 7. A ROOM, A HEAT DAY, AND A MAN WHO IS RIGHT ABOUT ONE STREET — CHAPTER 0179

**ON THURSDAY THE TWENTY-THIRD OF JULY 2015, THE FIRST DAY IN ABOUT SIX WEEKS THAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAD TO THINK ABOUT WEATHER, A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY-NINE WHO HAS LIVED ON HARKER STREET FOR TWELVE YEARS WENT INTO A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP ON A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS AND SAID ONE TRUE THING.**

- **WHAT HE SAID WAS FOURTEEN WORDS AND IT TOOK HIM TWELVE YEARS: THERE IS NOWHERE ON HARKER STREET TO SIT IN THE SHADE AFTER TWO O'CLOCK.** The pavement there has a wall with about two feet of shadow on it at four in July on one side and nothing at all on the other, and there are thirty-one doors, and he has counted them about four times this year because he keeps looking at them.
- **HE WAS ASKED WHO IT WAS FOR AND SAID HE DID NOT KNOW, AND THAT WAS THE HONEST ANSWER, and it is not for old people, it is for whoever is out in the street at four o'clock in July.** He has watched three men try to do it in a fortnight and one of them do it in a hat.
- **A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-FOUR, WHO DROVE THAT STREET TWICE A DAY FOR TWENTY-TWO YEARS IN A BUS, SAID THE OTHER HALF AND IT IS WHY THE ROOM IS GOING TO BE A PROBLEM: IN TWENTY-TWO YEARS THE ONE THING HE COULD HAVE DONE ABOUT ANYTHING ON THAT STREET WAS STOP AND SAY SOMETHING, AND THERE IS NO LIST, NO FORM AND NOBODY HE COULD HAVE RUNG, AND THAT HAS BEEN THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT THAT STREET AND IT IS GOING TO BE THE MOST DANGEROUS THING ABOUT IT, AND THE TWO THINGS ARE THE SAME THING. IF SOMETHING EVER DID HAPPEN ON THAT STREET, THE PERSON THIS BOROUGH WOULD COME TO IS HIM.**
- **HE SAID IT ABOUT HIMSELF, ONCE, AND DID NOT ASK FOR IT NOT TO BE MINUTED, AND NOTHING IS GOING TO BE MINUTED ANYWAY: he has never asked anybody for anything in twelve years and he is not going to start, and if somebody built him a bench on that street he would be the person who asked for it and then the person who can be asked why there is a bench, and in about two years he would be a man in a magazine with a photograph of a street with a man in it, and after that nobody on that street could say anything about the shade without him being in it.**
- **AND EVERYBODY IN THAT ROOM AGREED WITH HIM, AND THE AGREEING IS THE COST, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED IN THAT ROOM THIS AFTERNOON.** The woman of about fifty-eight, who has the keys, said it was right and said it was not on anything. The man of seventy-four said it was right and said he had driven past it two thousand times. **FROM THAT AFTERNOON HARKER STREET HAS A PERSON IN A BUILDING WHO IS RIGHT ABOUT IT, AND THAT IS NOT A SERVICE AND DOES NOT BECOME ONE AND IS NOT A DOCUMENT, AND THERE IS NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY THAT CAN STOP A BUILDING REMEMBERING A PERSON AND THERE IS NOT ONE THAT CAN TELL HIM IT HAS NOT REMEMBERED HIM EITHER, AND HE IS THE ONE WHO CAME.**
- **HE WAS ASKED NOTHING FOR THE WHOLE TIME HE WAS IN THAT ROOM.** A man of thirty-two has asked no question of anybody since the twenty-fifth of February and did not ask one, and it is the one afternoon in this borough where he could have asked two good ones and got good answers and it would have cost a man of sixty-nine about ninety seconds of his life. Nobody asked him his name and nobody asked which number he lives at and nobody wrote Harker Street down on anything.
- **AND THE HEAT DID NOTHING AND IT IS NOT GOING TO.** The window had been open since about one. Twenty-nine degrees. In 1998 it had been thirty-four. Nobody connected that to anything and nobody in that room suggested a tap, or a bottle of water, or a rota, or a form, or a list, or a shade, and nobody went out of the room. He walked to the parade, got on the bus, went nine stops to a shop he has been going to for twelve years, and the man of seventy-four said good afternoon to him on the stairs.

## 8. A FRIDAY UNDER THE STAIRS, AND THE FIRST DESTRUCTION OF THIS BOROUGH'S PAPERWORK IN NINE MONTHS — CHAPTER 0180

**ON FRIDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF JULY 2015 THE CUPBOARD UNDER THE STAIRS ON THE GROUND FLOOR OF THE OLD WARD WAS EMPTIED BY A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SIX, AND THE TRAY THAT WENT INTO IT ON THE TWENTY-NINTH OF JUNE WENT OUT AGAIN IN A SACK, AND THE SACK WENT INTO A SKIP.**

- **THE CUPBOARD IS EMPTIED ON A FRIDAY BY WHOEVER COMES THROUGH WITH A SACK. THERE IS NO ROTA FOR IT. THE BUILDING'S FRIDAY ROTA COVERS A DIFFERENT FLOOR AND HAS DONE SINCE ANYBODY CAN REMEMBER.** The man who came through with the sack is the same man who counted that shelf on the twenty-third of June, painted that room on the twenty-ninth, and carried the tray down those stairs at about nine on the twenty-ninth. **HE HAS NOT BEEN ASKED ABOUT THE TRAY, WAS NOT ASKED THEN, IS NOT BEING ASKED NOW AND IS NOT GOING TO BE.**
- **WHAT WAS IN THE TRAY, WHICH IS THE WHOLE OF WHAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH WILL EVER KNOW AND WHICH WAS SEEN BY THREE PEOPLE: three meeting notices for a group that has not met since March, one of them a second reminder with a different date on it; a parking notice for a yard, with a yard on it and a date in June on it and a line about vehicles, and NOBODY IN THAT BUILDING CAN PLACE THE YARD AND IT HAS NOT BEEN ASKED ABOUT; AND ABOUT FIFTY PAGES OF SOMETHING SENT ROUND IN ONE BUILDING IN APRIL TO A LIST SOMEBODY HELD, WHICH CAME BACK OFF THE FRIDAY ROUND ON THE NINETEENTH OF JUNE AND DID NOT GO OUT AGAIN.** Nobody looked at what the fifty pages were. Nobody in that building, nobody on the floor above, nobody in this city.
- **AND THE FIFTY PAGES ARE GONE, AND THE FIGURE OF ABOUT SIXTY PIECES OF POST HAS LEFT A BUILDING FOR THE LAST TIME, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A PIECE OF THIS BOROUGH'S PAPERWORK HAS ACTUALLY BEEN DESTROYED — NOT FILED, NOT MOVED, NOT PUT IN A CUPBOARD, NOT SCANNED. AND THE READER IS NOT TOLD WHETHER THAT IS A LOSS OR A CORRECTION, BOTH OF THOSE ARE AVAILABLE, THEY DO NOT EXCLUDE EACH OTHER, AND NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY CAN TELL WHICH ONE IT IS, BECAUSE TELLING WOULD REQUIRE SOMEBODY TO HAVE DECIDED, AND NOBODY DECIDED.**
- **THE ONLY INSTRUMENT THAT COULD SAY WHAT WAS IN THAT TRAY IS THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY WHO DECIDED IT, AND SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED, AND NOT BECAUSE SHE IS DIFFICULT. IF SHE IS ASKED, THEN IT WAS A DECISION; AND IF IT WAS A DECISION IT WAS MADE BY A PERSON; AND THE NEXT TIME A TRAY COMES BACK OFF A FRIDAY SOMEBODY WILL SAY *LAST TIME WE MADE A DECISION ABOUT A TRAY*, AND THE SECOND TIME A THING IS A DECISION IT HAS A PRECEDENT, AND A PRECEDENT HAS A NAME ON IT, AND THE NAME ON IT WOULD BE HERS.** She came down at about half past eight, stood in the doorway for about a minute and a half, said nothing, and went back up.
- **AND THE TWO OF THEM ARE BOTH ENTIRELY RIGHT AND NEITHER WILL EVER KNOW THAT THE OTHER ONE IS. She: it was post that came back and was never post again, a list would have cost a person, a tray cost a Friday, and on the day she made that choice it was the cheapest of the three things available to her and she was on her own time. He: it was a tray of paper, and paper is not a record, and nothing in that cupboard had a shelf, or a place, or a person, and a thing nobody can put a name on is a thing nobody can be asked about. Both are true and they cannot both be tested, because testing them means asking one of them a question, and asking is what turns it into a decision.**
- **HE STOOD IN THAT VESTIBULE FOR ABOUT TWENTY MINUTES AND SAID NOTHING AND ASKED NOTHING AND WROTE NOTHING DOWN AND DID NOT PICK UP A PAGE AND DID NOT READ ONE AND DID NOT ASK THE MAN OF THIRTY-SIX WHAT THE FIFTY PAGES WERE AND DID NOT ASK HIM TO REMEMBER.** Nothing at all was described in anything that leaves that building, because nothing was written.

## 9. A BENCH, A DUTY, AND THE ELEVENTH TIME — CHAPTER 0181

**ON SUNDAY THE TWENTY-SIXTH OF JULY 2015, FROM ABOUT TWO IN THE AFTERNOON, THERE IS A TWO-SLAT BENCH ON TWO CAST-IRON ENDS IN THE FORECOURT OF A BLOCK OF FLATS, WITH A PLATE ON THE IRON END THE SIZE OF A PLAYING CARD AND NOTHING WRITTEN ON IT, AND SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS OBLIGED TO DEAL WITH IT, AND THE DEALING IS NOT DONE.**

- **THE DUTY IS HELD BY A WORKS DEPOT ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE TRACKS. THE PERSON WHO DOES IT IS A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-SEVEN WITH A FLATBED AND A CLIPBOARD AND HE COMES TO THAT ESTATE WHEN HE IS ON THAT ESTATE. THE DEPOT GIVES HIM ABOUT NINE ESTATES A WEEK AND THE NINE ARE NOT THE SAME NINE EVERY WEEK, AND THE LIST OF THE NINE IS IN A BUILDING NOBODY IN THAT BLOCK HAS EVER SEEN. HE WAS LAST AT THAT BENCH IN APRIL AND HE HAS NOT BEEN BACK AND NOTHING WILL BRING HIM BACK.**
- **A DUTY IS AN ACT AND NOT A PLACE. THE DUTY IS NOT THE BENCH. THE BENCH IS A PLACE, AND A PLACE CAN BE POINTED AT, AND A PLACE THAT CAN BE POINTED AT IS A THING THIS BOROUGH HAS SPENT NINE MONTHS REFUSING TO PRODUCE. THE DUTY IS THAT SOMEBODY HAS TO LOOK AT IT, AND AN ACT HAS TO BE DONE BY A PERSON, AND THE PERSON IS NOT ON A ROTA, AND THE ROTA CANNOT BE REBUILT, AND THE REASON THE ROTA CANNOT BE REBUILT IS THAT NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS UNDER ANY OBLIGATION TO REBUILD IT.** Everybody knows it. Nobody says it. A rota is a list of people who cannot say no; put a name against that act and it is a job, and a job can be moved and a job can be asked why it did not happen, and it would be a young man on a Friday afternoon being asked where April went.
- **AND AT ABOUT TEN PAST TWO A WOMAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-ONE CAME OUT OF THE BLOCK WITH A CLOTH AND WIPED THE LEFT-HAND SLAT, AND SHE DID IT BECAUSE SHE WAS GOING TO SIT ON IT.** She had the cloth in her coat pocket, which means she knew before she came out that she was going to use it. There is grit on that slat and there has been since before April.
- **NOBODY IN THAT BLOCK SAW HER DO IT AND NOBODY IN THAT BLOCK KNOWS THAT A DUTY EXISTS THAT HAS NOT BEEN DONE, BECAUSE A DUTY THAT HAS NOT BEEN DONE IS A THING YOU CAN ONLY KNOW ABOUT FROM A LIST, AND THERE IS NO LIST IN THAT BLOCK, AND THERE IS A NOTICE ON THE WALL BY THE BIN STORE SAYING IN THREE LINES THAT NOBODY HAS TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT A BENCH, AND THAT NOTICE IS CORRECT, AND IT IS ALSO THE REASON NOBODY IN THAT BLOCK IS GOING TO BE TOLD. NOBODY LIVING IN THAT BUILDING WILL EVER KNOW, NOT THIS YEAR AND NOT AFTER THE MAN OF TWENTY-SEVEN COMES BACK IN NOVEMBER WITH A CLIPBOARD, BECAUSE THEN THE BENCH WILL BE CLEAN AND HE WILL HAVE NOTHING TO WRITE, AND A MAN WITH A CLIPBOARD WHO HAS NOTHING TO WRITE IS A MAN WHO HAS A CLEAN DAY.**
- **FOUR HUNDRED YARDS UP THE ROAD, PAST THE PARADE, IS THE OFFICE THAT WOULD KNOW WHEN THE MAN OF TWENTY-SEVEN COMES TO THAT ESTATE, AND IT WAS SHUT BECAUSE IT WAS SUNDAY. THAT IS A PLACE, AND A PLACE A MAN GOES TO IS THE FIRST HALF OF A SCHEDULE, AND HE HAD NO REASON TO BE IN IT AND WAS NOT IN IT AND IS NOT GOING TO BE IN IT ON A TUESDAY EITHER.** He could have asked one question on the Monday and got a correct answer, *as and when the round comes*, and the bench would have been the same on the last day of July as it was on the twenty-sixth.
- **AND THE CHAPTER SAYS THAT THIS IS THE ELEVENTH TIME THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN KEPT GOING BY A PERSON NOBODY IS OBLIGED TO NAME, AND IT DOES NOT COUNT THE ELEVENTH, BECAUSE COUNTING IT IS THE THING THAT WOULD STOP IT.** The ten before it are a woman of about fifty with a tray, a woman of about fifty-seven with a tray on a Friday, a woman of about sixty-five with a card in her window, a woman of about seventy-six with a bin, a woman of about thirty-one with four containers, a man of sixty-three with a bucket, a man of twenty-four with a crate he moved before he opened, a man of about twenty-six with a fan he carried in, a man of about forty-two with a towel, and a man of about forty-seven with a bag he was not asked about. **THREE OF THOSE TEN ENTRIES WERE WRONG IN BOTH THE CHAPTER AND THIS PARAGRAPH AND WERE CORRECTED IN A REVIEW REPAIR. There was no *man of twenty-four with a door he did not open*: 0168 has him opening a door and moving a crate before seven in the morning. There is no *man of about twenty-six with a fan* still holding one: 0168 has him carrying the fan in on the twenty-second of June, and it went out of that stockroom on the first of July. And there is no *man of about thirty-five with a bag* anywhere in this volume: the only man of about thirty-five in it is the man who sleeps in that stockroom and knows nothing, and the bag was a plastic bag with a tap washer in it belonging to the man of about forty-seven who repairs washing machines, in 0170, who was told three correct things about June and was not asked anything.** **THE REASON IT IS NOT THE ELEVENTH IS THAT THE TWO OF THOSE LISTS ARE A LIST, AND A LIST OF PEOPLE WHO DID THINGS IS A LIST OF PEOPLE, AND A PERSON WHO IS WRITTEN DOWN TO DO A THING IS A PERSON SOMEBODY CAN RING ABOUT IT, AND A WOMAN OF SEVENTY-ONE WITH A CLOTH IN HER COAT POCKET IS THE SAFEST PERSON IN THIS CITY THIS AFTERNOON AND SHE WILL STAY THAT WAY FOR EXACTLY AS LONG AS NOBODY COUNTS HER.**

## 10. A DOORSTEP, AND NOBODY WHO WILL EVER KNOW WHICH OF THE TWO THINGS HAPPENED — CHAPTER 0182

**ON TUESDAY THE TWENTY-EIGHTH OF JULY 2015 A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-ONE WENT ROUND ABOUT FORTY DOORS ON A STREET NEAR THE MARKET SAYING ONE SENTENCE OUT LOUD, AND AT ONE DOOR A WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-NINE SAID A DIFFERENT SENTENCE, AND THE COUNT OF STANDING REFUSALS DID NOT MOVE.**

- **HE HAS A CLIPBOARD AND A PLASTIC WALLET AND A BUILDING BEHIND HIM AND THERE IS NO FORM. THE INSTRUMENT IS THE CHEAPEST ONE ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS PUT IN FRONT OF A HOUSEHOLD AND IT WORKS BECAUSE IT CANNOT BE REFUSED PROPERLY WITHOUT A PIECE OF PAPER TO REFUSE ON. WHAT HE NEEDS IS FOR A PERSON TO SAY *I WILL BE IN TOUCH IN THE SECOND WEEK OF AUGUST* OUT LOUD, IN FRONT OF HIM, SO THAT HE CAN WRITE ON A LINE THAT READS *SAID BY RESIDENT*. HE TOLD HER AT THE DOOR THAT SHE COULD SAY NO AND THAT HE WOULD WRITE *DECLINED* AND WOULD NOT COME BACK, AND ALL OF THAT WAS CORRECT.**
- **SHE SAID NOTHING FOR ABOUT TWELVE SECONDS AND THEN SAID ONE SENTENCE: *YOU'D WANT ME TO SAY IT NOW.*** He said he would, because he was there. **THEN SHE SAID THE OTHER HALF OF IT AND IT WAS THE CORRECT THING TO HAVE SAID: in August, if somebody comes, she will open the door and answer whatever she is asked, and if she is asked her name she will give it to her, in her own front door, to their face, and NOT IN JULY TO A LAD WITH A SHEET — because then the paper will be right and it will be in a building and there will be a person in the building who is right about her, and that is how it starts.**
- **HE SAID *RIGHT* AND WENT ON DOWN THE STREET. HE DID NOT WRITE ANYTHING ON THE SHEET FOR THAT DOOR. HE DID NOT WRITE *DECLINED*. HE DID NOT KNOCK AGAIN, CALL BACK, OR LEAVE A NOTE. HE PUT THE SHEET UNDER THE BOARD AND SAID GOOD AFTERNOON TO THE NEXT HOUSE AND DID THE SENTENCE OUT LOUD ON THAT DOORSTEP AS WELL, because he was doing his job. SHE SHUT THE DOOR. IT WAS NOT A SLAM.**
- **THE COUNT IS ELEVEN AND NOT TWELVE AND THIS WAS NOT A TWELFTH. A REQUEST REFUSED TWICE IS ONE REQUEST AND NOT TWO. SHE WAS NOT ASKED TWICE. NOTHING WAS PUT TO HER IN A FORM AND THERE WAS NO FORM AND SHE DID NOT REFUSE ANYTHING THAT HAD BEEN REQUIRED OF HER, BECAUSE NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH CAN REQUIRE ANYTHING OF ANYBODY.**
- **AND NOBODY WROTE IT DOWN AND NOBODY IS GOING TO APPEAL IT, AND THOSE TWO THINGS ARE THE ONLY REASON IT WORKS. Not discretion, not kindness, not anybody's care for her. If a refusal has to be written down then it is a document, and a document is a thing a building keeps, and then the person who refused is a person somebody can ask what she refused and why and when. If a refusal can be appealed then the person who refuses has to be in a position, and a position is a place you can be found. Neither of those is true here.** She will never know her sentence was the correct one. He will never know whether she refused him or negotiated with him, and he will take thirty-nine lines back to that building on the Friday with a blank where the fortieth should be.
- **A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WALKED UP THAT STREET AT ABOUT TEN PAST THREE AND WAS NOT WATCHING AND WAS NOT HIM.** He was in a queue in a shop for about six minutes and came out to see a young man with a clipboard doing his sentence on the fortieth door, and he did not know which door was the one and he would not have turned round for a young man with a clipboard on a Tuesday. He asked nobody anything, nobody asked him anything, **he may not chair anything and there is no chair of that body**, and none of it touched him. He will not be told any of it and there is no version of the next fortnight in which he finds out that a woman of forty-nine got a young man to leave a line blank by being correct at him on her own doorstep in about four minutes.
- The young man will be on that street again in the second week of August and will say it on forty, and nobody is going to know that the reason he has thirty-nine is a woman who was kind to him.

## 11. A CORNER SHOP, A MONTH OF BEING LEFT ALONE, AND THIRTY — CHAPTER 0183

**ON THURSDAY THE THIRTIETH OF JULY 2015, FROM ABOUT HALF PAST TEN IN THE MORNING, THERE WAS NOTHING WRONG WITH A CORNER SHOP ON A STREET OF TERRACES BEHIND THE MARKET, AND IT HAD BEEN LEFT ALONE FOR FOUR WEEKS, AND IT WAS STRONGER.**

- **THE ONLY NEW THING IN THAT SHOP IS THE CARD IN THE WINDOW, WHICH IS THE SHOP'S OWN TELEPHONE NUMBER AND NOTHING ELSE, LEFT ON THE SIXTH OF JULY, NOT MOVED, NOT TAKEN DOWN, NOT A FORM, AND IT REFERS TO NOTHING IN THAT BUILDING. The woman who keeps the shop was asked not to say who left it and not to write it down. **NOBODY HAS TOLD HER ANYTHING SINCE, SHE DOES NOT KNOW ANYTHING, SHE IS NOT A THREAD, SHE IS OWED NOTHING AND SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE TOLD.**
- **AND WHAT HAS HAPPENED IN THREE WEEKS IS THAT STRANGERS HAVE BEEN COMING IN AND ASKING HER ABOUT IT, MOST DAYS, MOSTLY AT ABOUT HALF PAST TEN AND MOSTLY AT ABOUT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON, AND THEY ARE ORDINARY AND OFTEN YOUNG AND NEARLY ALWAYS POLITE, AND THEY ASK WHETHER IT IS THE NUMBER FOR THE WOMAN WHO SORTS THE BINS ON THAT STREET, AND SHE SAYS *THAT'S THE SHOP'S NUMBER*, AND IF THEY ASK WHETHER IT IS THE SAME ONE SHE SAYS *IT'S THE SHOP'S NUMBER*, AND THEY SAY THANK YOU AND GO.** Nobody has ever said her name in that shop in connection with that card. She has not written one word about it anywhere. **IT HAS BEEN ABOUT THIRTY TIMES IN THREE WEEKS AND NOBODY HAS COUNTED IT AND IT IS NOT A COUNT OF ANYTHING EXCEPT A THING SHE DID. She is not certain of the number and is certain of the shape of it, and it has not once been a bad interaction and has not once been a row.**
- **THE MECHANISM IS THE ONE FROM JUNE AND IT IS NOT NEW: a shop is not a person, and a shop is also a thing that is open, at a number, on a street, and a thing that is open at a number is a route. Somebody wanted to be a person who could not be asked after and made a route instead, and the route is a shop, and the shop is staffed, and the woman who staffs it is about sixty-five and has a card rail by the door and cannot refuse.** Each of those thirty times a sentence about a woman who sorts the bins on that street got a little more fixed in a place it was not supposed to be.
- **AND BEING LEFT ALONE IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAS EVER WORKED IN THIS BOROUGH, AND IT HAS WORKED, AND IT IS NOT SAID AS AN ACHIEVEMENT.** The shop is busier than it was in June. There is more milk and more of the cold things and a second carrier bag roll and two people in there at about eleven most days who are not neighbours. The card rail gets fuller by about one card a week from shops up the road, which is what a shop rail does. **AND SHE HAS BOUGHT A SECOND FRIDGE, WHICH SHE COULD NOT HAVE JUSTIFIED TO ANYBODY IN APRIL AND WHICH IS JUSTIFIED BY NOTHING AND WHICH IS FULL. A thing left alone for four weeks is either stronger or finished and there is no instrument in this city that says which, and this is the outside of one street of terraces on the thirtieth of July, and it is stronger, and that is not an achievement and it is not a policy and it is not going to be in a minute.**
- **AND IT IS NOT STRONGER FOR ANYBODY. NOBODY IN THAT SHOP HAS BEEN HELPED BY THE CARD.** What has been counted in that shop in three weeks is the number of times a stranger has been told that a number is the shop's number, and that is not a number of anybody at all. **AND THE COST OF IT IS THE ONLY COST OF IT: a woman of about sixty-five who has done the same thing about thirty times and is not going to stop and is not going to say anything about it, and there is no version of the next three months in which anybody finds out, and that is what the thirty is.**
- **AND HE COULD HAVE ASKED HER ONE QUESTION, WITH THE SHOP EMPTY, AND SHE WOULD HAVE ANSWERED IT, AND HE DID NOT, AND THE REASON IS A THING ABOUT HIM AND NOT A THING ABOUT HER AND IS NOT THE PRICE AND IS NOT A PRINCIPLE.** He is the only man in this borough who could be believed, and that is the plain result of nine months in which almost every true thing anybody has heard in a room in this borough came out of his mouth, and a man who is believed about a street is a man somebody will come to about a street. **If a man of thirty-two walks into that shop and asks a second question about that card, the shop becomes a place where a card is a subject, and a shop is a thing that is open at a number on a street, and he has said that out loud, in a corridor, to a woman of twenty-nine, in July, and he was right, and he is not going to be the man who puts her in it twice.** He bought a bag of washing-up liquid, which is what he came in for, and did not look at the card on the way out, and asked her nothing at all.
- **THE WOMAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-SIX AT THE TOP OF THAT STREET IS STILL CARRYING HER OWN BIN UP HER OWN PATH, AND SHE IS NOT GOING TO MENTION IT, AND NOBODY HAS ASKED HER.** That loop was not closed by anybody in this batch and is not going to be.

**THE DIFFERENCE IS THE LAST TEN DAYS OF JULY, AND IT IS THREE THINGS AND ONE NEW THING.** Two of the things in it have now been going for seven weeks — the chair on that landing, which has gone out at about eight in the evening and come in at about six since about the middle of June, and the printed sheet of the nineteenth of June, which is in its seventh week and has a second copy with an empty column on it. One of them has got a second copy and neither was withdrawn. **AND THE ONE ITEM THAT IS NEW IS NOT A DOCUMENT AND NOT A FORM AND NOT A PAGE AND NOT A BUILDING AND IT IS THE THIRD SMALLEST THING ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS PRODUCED, THE CHAIR ON A LANDING BEING SMALLER AND THE TWO TRESTLE TABLES BEING SMALLER THAN IT: SINCE ABOUT THE TWENTIETH OF JULY THERE HAS BEEN A BOTTLE OF WATER ON A TOP STEP OUTSIDE A DOOR ON ONE OF THOSE FOUR STREETS.** It is there in the morning and it is not there in the evening, nobody has said whose it is and nobody has moved it, the people on that street have not mentioned it, and one of them has drunk out of it on most mornings since. **NOBODY IS REQUIRED TO PUT IT THERE OR TAKE IT AWAY AND IT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF ANYTHING.**

**THE BATCH'S ENDING QUESTION IS NEW AND IT IS NOT ABOUT A PERSON AND IT IS NOT THE QUESTION BATCH 0003 ENDED ON, BATCH 0002 ENDED ON, BATCH 0001 ENDED ON OR VOLUME 03 ENDED ON, AND IT IS NOT ABOUT A FLOOD BARRIER, A SCHOOL CROSSING, A COUNTER-AMENDMENT, A SECOND SIGNATURE, A PROVISIONAL CIVIC STANDING, A NINETY-DAY RENEWAL OR AN ORDER: there are more things in this borough that have been done once, correctly, and then not done again and not written down, than there were in June, every one of them is still true, none of them is on anything, and IN NINE MONTHS NOT ONE OF THEM HAS EVER BEEN PROVED BY ANYBODY. A thing done once and not written down is a thing that four people remember differently, and if one of them talks it is a story, and if a building hears a story it is a record. SO WHICH OF THEM IS THE FIRST ONE SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH WILL BE ABLE TO PROVE, AND IS IT GOING TO BE PROVED BY A PERSON WHO WAS STANDING THERE, OR BY A PERSON WHO READS ABOUT IT AFTERWARDS.**

**THE QUESTION BATCH 0003 ENDED ON — WHICH OF THE EIGHT DATED THINGS IS THE FIRST ONE SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH DECIDES TO KEEP, AND WHETHER IT IS KEPT BECAUSE IT WAS GOOD OR BECAUSE IT WAS EXPENSIVE — WAS NOT ANSWERED, WAS NOT RESTATED, AND REMAINS OPEN. **COUNCILLOR IVEN SORE PUT IT ON A TABLE OUT LOUD AT ABOUT HALF PAST TWO IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM, WITH EIGHT PEOPLE IN IT, AND EVERY SENTENCE SHE SAID WAS CORRECT, AND SHE IS NOT A MENACE AND SHE IS NOT WRONG AND SHE WAS NOT IMPROVED ON.** She said the May emergency was handled by about four people and that four people is what the borough has and is the only thing that has ever worked here, and she said she is not going to tell anybody that four people is not enough, and she said she has spent nine months watching people be frightened of the day somebody writes down who the four are.

PRECEDENCE — where two services disagree about what happens first, this order decides which one goes first; it is decided by a person; a person is a person and not a committee. 2. THE FIELD — the order is administered in a field, and the field holds four things, a person's name, the hour the person was called, the hour the person went home, and the thing the person was called for, AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD. 3. THE CALL — a person in this district may be called on to work; a person who has been called on may not decline; the call is made by a person; the call is not required to be in writing and there is no form for it. 4. CLOSURE — where a hazard is inside a district boundary the district may be closed; a closure is not required to be heard before it is made; a closure is posted on the street it closes. 5. ## 19. THE MEASURING PASS ON CHAPTERS 185–192, AND WHAT IT CAUGHT, AND THE ONE DEFECT IT FOUND IN THE PROMPT

**REPAIRED IN THE PROSE, ALL ELEVEN, AND NONE OF THEM CHANGED A CARD, A BEAT OR A DATE:**

1. **"NOBODY IN THIS VOLUME ANSWERS IT" IN THE DECK OF 0192.** A self-reference to a volume, in the one chapter that is the end of a volume. **IT IS NOW *NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH ANSWERS IT*.** One self-reference, caught and cut.

EVERY *THE NINTH OF SEPTEMBER* IN THE PROSE OF 0190 AND 0191 IS NOW *THAT WEDNESDAY* OR *THE WEDNESDAY*, ELEVEN INSTANCES, AND THE ONE THAT REMAINS IS THE DATELINE OF 0190, WHICH IS A CALENDAR DATE AND HAS A MONTH ON IT AND IS NOT AN ORDINAL.** This is the second-largest single defect in the batch and it is the same defect three chapters in this account have already had repaired for.

## 20. THE INDEPENDENT REVIEW OF CHAPTERS 185–192, WHAT IT CAUGHT, AND WHAT THE MEASURING PASS DID NOT CATCH

**THE EIGHT THAT MATTERED MOST, ALL OF THEM REPAIRED IN THE PROSE:**

1. **THE ORDER WAS NINE PAGES AND TWO PAGES IN THE SAME CHAPTER.** 0186 said *IT IS NINE PAGES OF PAPER* and then printed *PAGE ONE OF TWO*, and page two is the last page and the blank is at the foot of it, which is what the whole volume's argument is standing on. **THE INSTRUMENT IS TWO PAGES, AND THE SECOND OF THEM IS THE LAST OF THEM.** 0187, 0189, 0190 and 0192 said *nine pages* in four places and all four are now *two pages* or *the whole of it*, and §5, §8, §9 and §11, the batch summary, `state/current.md`, `state/character-state.md` and Section E of `outline/volume-04.md` all carry it.

## 6. THE ORDER AS IT STANDS AT THE CLOSE OF THE VOLUME, AND IT MAY NOT BE ALTERED IN ONE WORD

**MADE THURSDAY THE THIRTEENTH OF AUGUST 2015, IN FORCE, TWO PAGES, AND THE SECOND OF THEM IS THE LAST OF THEM. READ ALOUD IN DAYLIGHT IN A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP ON A PARADE OF SHOPS IN TIDEGLASS TO FOUR PEOPLE.**

1. **PRECEDENCE** — where two services disagree about what happens first, this order decides which one goes first; it is decided by a person; a person is a person and not a committee.
2. **THE FIELD** — the order is administered in a field, and the field holds four things, a person's name, the hour the person was called, the hour the person went home, and the thing the person was called for, **AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD.**
3. **THE CALL** — a person in this district may be called on to work; a person who has been called on may not decline; the call is made by a person; the call is not required to be in writing and there is no form for it.
4. **CLOSURE** — where a hazard is inside a district boundary the district may be closed; a closure is not required to be heard before it is made; a closure is posted on the street it closes.
5. **TRANSFER** — where a person is to be moved from one site to another, the sending site holds precedence over the receiving site until the receiving site has confirmed capacity **IN WRITING**.
6. **THE SECOND CALL** — a person whose name is in the field may be called again at any time, without limit, and no person may decline a second call.
7. **RENEWAL** — this order stands for ninety days from the date of making; at the end of that period it is renewed or it is not renewed; page two.

**PAGE TWO, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE VOLUME'S ARGUMENT ARRIVING INSIDE A MECHANISM: *This order is renewed on the eleventh of November 2015, or it is not renewed.* AGREED BY — and the line goes down the page and stops about two inches from the bottom edge and there is nothing after it.**

- **THE NINETY DAYS IS A RENEWAL CLAUSE AND NOT AN EXPIRY. NOBODY RENEWED IT AND NOBODY EXPIRED IT AND NOBODY RENEWNED IT, AND THE DATE IS KNOWN, NAMED ON PAGE TWO, AND UNANSWERED, AND THE VOLUME ENDS WITH IT UNANSWERED, AND WHETHER ANYBODY RENEWS AND WHETHER ANYBODY RENAMES THE BLANK TERM ARE VOLUME 05'S BUSINESS.** No date, read time, start time or expiry may ever be put on any clause.
- **THE ORDER IS VALID AND IT WORKS AND IT WORKS BY PUTTING A PERSON IN A FIELD. IT IS THE ONLY INSTRUMENT ANYBODY IN THIS CITY HAS EVER WRITTEN DOWN THAT WOULD WORK. IT IS NOT SOFTENED BY ANYTHING IN THE CLOSE AND IT IS NOT TOUCHED BY THE CLOSE AT ALL.**

**0195 THURSDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF SEPTEMBER 2015, FROM ABOUT TEN IN THE MORNING, PEVERELL STREET · 0196 WEDNESDAY THE THIRTIETH OF SEPTEMBER, FROM ABOUT ELEVEN IN THE MORNING, A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP · 0197 TUESDAY THE SIXTH OF OCTOBER, FROM ABOUT TEN PAST SIX IN THE MORNING, A YARD ENTRANCE · 0198 MONDAY THE TWELFTH OF OCTOBER, FROM ABOUT TEN TO FIVE IN THE MORNING, THE BOTTOM OF PEVERELL STREET · 0199 SUNDAY THE EIGHTEENTH OF OCTOBER, FROM ABOUT HALF PAST TWO IN THE AFTERNOON, A ROOM OVER A SHOP · 0200 SATURDAY THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF OCTOBER, FROM ABOUT TEN IN THE MORNING, THE OPEN COVENANTS LEGAL CLINIC · 0201 FRIDAY THE THIRTIETH OF OCTOBER, FROM ABOUT HALF PAST THREE IN THE AFTERNOON, A CANTEEN · 0202 TUESDAY THE THIRD OF NOVEMBER, FROM ABOUT HALF PAST THREE IN THE AFTERNOON, A FIRST-FLOOR ROOM OVER A SHOP · 0203 SATURDAY THE SEVENTH OF NOVEMBER, FROM ABOUT HALF PAST TEN IN THE MORNING, A HALL OFF A PARADE OF SHOPS · 0204 TUESDAY THE TENTH OF NOVEMBER, FROM ABOUT SIX IN THE EVENING, THE LOW END OF PEVERELL STREET. ALL TEN IN TIDEGLASS.**

Every weekday was checked against the real 2015 calendar and every one is right. The gaps are 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 4, 4 and 3 days, all inside the three-to-seven-day window, no chapter is dated to a day before the one before it, and no chapter is dated before Thursday the twenty-fourth of September. **THE BATCH MAY NOT BE DATED PAST TUESDAY THE TENTH OF NOVEMBER 2015, AND IT IS NOT: WEDNESDAY THE ELEVENTH OF NOVEMBER IS A DAY AWAY AND WAS NOT REACHED, NAMED, COUNTED DOWN OR RESOLVED IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS, AND IT IS NOT NAMED ON THE PAGE IN ANY OF THEM.**

**THE CHAPTERS ARE 1,890 / 1,914 / 1,553 / 1,844 / 1,794 / 1,492 / 1,621 / 1,824 / 1,537 / 1,114 WORDS, A MEDIAN OF 1,707.5 AGAINST A VOLUME 04 BATCH 0005 MEDIAN OF 2,489, AND 16,583 WORDS IN THE BATCH. EVERY FIGURE WAS MEASURED FROM THE CHAPTERS AFTER THE REPAIRS IN §15 AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD FROM ANY SUMMARY. **THE METHOD IS STATED BECAUSE THE FIGURES WERE WRONG TWICE BEFORE THEY WERE RIGHT: `wc -w` ON THE CHAPTER FILE, WHOLE FILE, TITLE LINE INCLUDED, WHICH IS REPRODUCIBLE AND IS WHAT THESE FIGURES ARE.** AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK GAVE 1,884 / 1,894 / 1,546 / 1,839 / 1,766 / 1,500 / 1,583 / 1,814 / 1,527 / 1,104, TOTAL 16,457, MEDIAN 1,675, WHICH WAS EXACTLY FIVE SHORT ON EVERY CHAPTER BY AN UNDOCUMENTED METHOD, AND THAT LINE WAS SUPERSEDED RATHER THAN CORRECTED IN PLACE.** 0204 IS THE SHORTEST IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE 0191 AND IS SHORT BECAUSE THE CARD IS AN ORDINARY EVENING AND TWO PEOPLE AND A GULLY, AND IT IS NOT PADDED AND IT IS NOT TRIMMED.**

## 1. THE PERMISSION FROM ALDERWICK, AND WHAT IT IS, AND WHAT IT COST

**A MUTUAL-AID PERMISSION CAME DOWN FROM A CITY ON THE OTHER BANK ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER 2015, AND IT IS TWO PAGES, CORRECT IN EVERY SENTENCE, SIGNED AT BOTH ENDS, AND IT IS ABOUT A PERSON BY NAME, AND IT IS THE FIRST DOCUMENT ABOUT A PERSON BY NAME IN NINE MONTHS.** Its clauses: a person named in the schedule may be asked to work in the other city for not exceeding fourteen days; a person asked takes the work or does not take it, at the hour the work begins; a person named is paid the going rate, at the printed rate, in money, in full, before the work begins; a person named keeps a right of return on the day the work ends without asking anybody for anything; where a person is receiving care in one city the other city pays that care and the person does not move; a claim arising out of work done under the permission is made in the city where the work was done and not in the city the person came from; and nothing in the permission requires a person to be asked, to be found, to be named, or to be told anything. Reference AM/15/221. The schedule carries **nine** names. **THERE IS NO LINE UNDER EITHER SIGNATURE WITH NOTHING IN IT, AND THAT IS THE FIRST THING JONAS MERCER LOOKED AT, AND THE ONLY THING ABOUT THE PAGE THAT MADE HIM STOP FOR MORE THAN A SECOND. SOMEBODY IN THIS CITY SIGNED IT ON MONDAY AT A COUNTER IN A BUILDING BY THE WATER, AND NOBODY IN THE ROOM COULD HAVE SAID WHICH OF THE PEOPLE ON THAT COUNTER, AND THE WATER OFFICE DOES NOT HAVE A LIST EITHER.** Signed for Alderwick by a woman of about fifty-two, Irene Sandiford, a duty clerk, who is correct in every sentence she says, is not the person who agreed to it, said so twice, and is not available to be asked about it. She came on the morning train on the thirtieth and again on the third of November and went back on the twelve-fifteen and the six.

**THE FINDING OF THE BATCH IS ABOUT WHAT IT DID TO PEOPLE AND IT IS NOT A SCANDAL AND IT IS NOT A RESCUE. Three things happened and all three are correct and none of them helps anybody.**

- **A PERSON THIS BOROUGH COULD NOT FIND WAS FOUND, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH ASKED FOR THAT.** **EWEN ASHGROVE, ABOUT SIXTY-TWO**, walked out of one room on the second floor of a house in Kilburn Street in the second week of April with a bag. The room was let again in June. Fourteen days' rent, about ninety pounds, has been in a tin in a drawer since April, and the person who let the room has been to three places in this city about it and has been told the correct thing at all three. The eighth row of the schedule says he is at Alderwick in a rented room in a work contract of fourteen days at a time, renewed six times, present since 11 August 2015. **A duty clerk was sent a schedule to fill in, one of the names on it went to a person who had been carrying it, and the person sent it on, because a schedule with a name on it is a schedule with a name on it and nobody had a reason to take one out.** He is not missing and nobody was in danger and nobody was sent for and nobody was brought back.
- **THE THING THAT LEFT.** **A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-SEVEN**, who has his own tipper and a flatbed and does work for whoever pays him and is on no rota and on nothing, went across the water on **Tuesday 6 October** for fourteen days, was told at about ten past six in the morning at a yard entrance by a man of about sixty-seven from the water side who had met him once in June, and who read a line off a folded piece of A4 that he then put in his pocket. He had said yes on Saturday the third. Nobody told him in between. The money is in an envelope in the cab before the work and it is the going rate for the work over there and it is more than the going rate here. He went, he is all right, he is paid, and he is gone. **THE BOROUGH HAS NEVER HAD A MECHANISM FOR A PERSON COMING BACK AND THERE IS NOT GOING TO BE ONE**, because a right of return needs nothing and a mechanism for a return needs somebody to be in it. **THE CHAPTER HE WAS TOLD AT SAYS HE WOULD BE BACK ON THE TWENTIETH, AND THAT IS THE DATE CARRIED FORWARD, AND AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK THAT SAID HE CAME BACK ON MONDAY 19 OCTOBER IS WRONG: 19 OCTOBER 2015 WAS A MONDAY BUT IT IS NOT A DATE ANY CHAPTER GIVES AND IT IS NOT THE END OF FOURTEEN DAYS FROM THE SIXTH.** He is out again on Thursdays and drove his own tipper past the end of Peverell Street at about half past six on the evening of Tuesday 10 November. He is on nothing, is owed nothing, is not a thread, and has not been asked one question by anybody in either city.
- **THE THING THAT WAS FOUND TURNED OUT NOT TO HAVE ASKED TO BE FOUND.** **ON TUESDAY 3 NOVEMBER ASHGROVE CAME ACROSS THE ESTUARY ON THE MONDAY MORNING BOAT ON HIS OWN ACCOUNT, HAVING BEEN TOLD ON FRIDAY 30 OCTOBER THAT HIS DETAILS HAD BEEN PASSED TO A CITY HE HAD LEFT, TO FIND OUT WHY, AND HE SAID THE SENTENCE HIMSELF: NOBODY ASKED ME TO BE FOUND. HE SAID IT TWICE AND BOTH TIMES IT WAS TRUE, AND NOBODY OBJECTED TO ANY PART OF IT.** He said what it cost him, which is nothing: that nobody had come and found him, that nobody had sent anybody, that he had a room and a contract and the money comes in an envelope before the work, and that he would not go back to the room in Kilburn Street on a Tuesday. **HE DESCRIBED THE MOMENT AS HE WAS AT ALDERWICK ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER, ON A CONTRACT HE HAD BEEN ON SINCE AUGUST, WITH A CLERK IN THAT CITY WRITING HIS NAME IN A LINE ON A PIECE OF A4, AND A FIRST DRAFT HAD PUT HIM ON A GULLY IN A THIRD CITY HE HAD NEVER LIVED IN WITH A WOMAN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE WATER WRITING HIS NAME, WHICH IS A THIRD PARTY TO A TWO-PARTY PERMISSION AND IS NOT TRUE AND WAS CUT.** He said the second half of it, which is the part nobody in the room wanted: **he is now carrying a doctor in a town he cannot name, on the other side of the water, paid for out of a council that has never heard of him, under a clause that is correct, and he cannot say no to it, and he would like to, and the only way anybody can get out of this arrangement is to write, and he has not written anything to anybody since he was twenty-two and is not going to start in order to be tidy.** He is going back on the half-past-five boat on the day.
- **AND THE SEVEN ROWS ARE RECONCILED WITH THE NINE NAMES, BECAUSE NOBODY HAD DONE IT.** The sheet Sandiford brought back on 3 November is a different sheet from the one she read out on 30 September: it is the sheet that gets filled in when the fourteen days run out, it carries **seven** rows, six of them already dated, and the seventh is his, in her own hand, because she had written it on a train. **A RETURN SHEET IS NOT THE SCHEDULE AND IS NOT SUPPOSED TO CARRY NINE ROWS. SIX OF THE NINE TOOK WORK AND SIX CAME BACK WITH DATES ON IT, AND THE SEVENTH IS THE ONE WHO CAME ACROSS THE ESTUARY ON HIS OWN ACCOUNT, AND THE EIGHTH AND NINTH ARE NOT ON THAT SHEET AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS ASKED WHY.** His row reads **contract renewed six times**, which is what the schedule of 30 September also said and which is arithmetically exact: fourteen days from 11 August 2015 comes round for the sixth time on **3 November 2015**, the day he was in the room.

**AND THE COST FELL WHERE THE COST FALLS IN THIS ACCOUNT, WHICH IS ON A PERSON WHO CANNOT BE FOUND AND CANNOT BE ASKED. A woman of about thirty-eight in that room said the true thing — a permission finds people the same way the August document finds them, and the only difference is the handwriting and the fact that one of them was signed twice — and stopped, because a person in a room saying that is heard as an objection, and she was not objecting, and about four people in that room thought the same sentence at the same moment and about four of them had worked out before now that this city has no instrument for saying a true thing without it also sounding like a complaint.**

## 2. THE RAIN OF MONDAY 12 OCTOBER, AND WHAT IT COST, AND THE THING NOBODY CAN FIND OUT

**THE RAIN CAME IN FROM THE WEST DURING THE NIGHT OF SUNDAY 11 OCTOBER, STOPPED BEING HEAVY AT ABOUT HALF PAST SEVEN ON THE MONDAY AND STOPPED ALTOGETHER AT ABOUT ELEVEN, AND NOBODY DIED, NOBODY WAS IN A HOSPITAL BECAUSE OF THE WATER, NOBODY WAS SENT FOR, AND NOBODY WAS FETCHED.** The run at the bottom of Peverell Street was at six inches on Thursday the twenty-fourth of September and was at two feet and rising at ten to five. About five people were on that ground and they are the same four or five as they were in May, in June and in August, and they are not chosen, they are not on anything, they cannot be sent for, and there is nothing anywhere in this city that could put a sixth person into a yard at ten to five in the morning, and a body that cannot require anybody cannot be told what it will do. **THE SPILL OF 16 MAY WAS NOT RE-DERIVED, IMPROVED ON OR USED AS A DISCOVERY AND IS NOT MENTIONED IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

**AND AT ABOUT TEN TO FIVE SOMEBODY WENT ALONG THE OLD BRICK BASE OF A CLOSE-BOARDED FENCE AND PULLED THREE BOARDS OFF THE BOTTOM, AND THE WATER WENT THROUGH, AND THE WALL STOOD.** Jonas Mercer was about ten feet away with a spade facing the other way, heard it, turned round, and saw a light behind a man and a set of boots and then there was nothing. He did not see a face and **HE DID NOT ASK, AND THERE IS NOBODY IN THIS CITY HE COULD HAVE SAID IT TO EVEN IF HE HAD.** Two doorways in that yard stayed dry. A yard next door took about a foot on the floor of a workshop and a man of about seventy-seven lost a shelf of stock and said that anybody with a bucket could have done it, which was true, and then said that there is no way on God's earth of finding out who, which was also true. **THE THREE BOARDS WENT DOWN THE YARD AND UNDER THE RUN AND WERE NOT SEEN AGAIN. THE TWO PEOPLE WHO MIGHT HAVE BEEN ASKED WERE ABOUT FORTY FEET AWAY WITH THEIR BACKS TO IT AND NEITHER TURNED ROUND, AND NEITHER HAS SAID A WORD ABOUT IT SINCE AND NEITHER IS GOING TO BE ASKED.** The water went down an inch an hour from about ten and was gone properly by about two in the afternoon. The man of about seventy-seven finished on about six of his own bags and Jonas Mercer carried four of them up the street without saying why and he said nothing and took them.

## 3. THE FINDING ABOUT A PERMISSION AND AN OBLIGATION, AND IT IS NOT ANSWERED

**ON SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER, IN A ROOM OVER A SHOP, IN DAYLIGHT, IN FRONT OF ABOUT NINE PEOPLE, TOMAS RENN SAID THE SENTENCE NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS SAID OUT LOUD IN A ROOM: A PERMISSION AND AN OBLIGATION ARE OPPOSITES, AND THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN LIVING ON THE SECOND ONE FOR NINE MONTHS AND WAS HANDED THE FIRST ONE EIGHTEEN DAYS EARLIER IN PRINT. **THE INTERVAL IS EIGHTEEN DAYS BECAUSE THE PERMISSION CAME DOWN ON WEDNESDAY 30 SEPTEMBER AND THIS MEETING IS SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER, AND IT IS NOT SIX DAYS; AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK AND FOUR STATE FILES SAID SIX DAYS, WHICH IS NOT ANY INTERVAL IN THIS ACCOUNT, AND IT WAS CORRECTED IN THE PROSE OF 0199 AND HERE RATHER THAN PROPAGATED.** His full sentence: one of them is a door and the other one is a hand on it, and this borough has been standing on the hand for nine months and it has worked, and the reason it has worked is that the only thing anybody has ever been able to put on anybody in this city is a hand, and the hand does not need a reason, and nobody has ever been able to write the reason down.

**HE IS RIGHT AND HE IS NOT SOFTENED AND JONAS MERCER IS RIGHT TOO AND HE COULD NOT IMPROVE IT AND DID NOT TRY.** Renn put three things that have been minuted since the beginning of the year and are still correct: a bond, which is not money but something a person has to hand over before taking a decision that affects other people and gets back if the decision was right; tools that belong to nobody, one set at the shop on a Friday for anybody with a job and no van; and **the person who does the work saying whether the work is safe — which is clause one, clause three and the field in clause two with four things in it of the document made on 13 August, and which Renn asked for in a room like that one in March, **THAT THE ORDER'S CLAUSE TWO IS THE FIELD, WHICH 0199 NOW NAMES AS CLAUSE TWO BECAUSE THE ONLY CORRECT WAY TO NAME IT IS BY ITS NUMBER**, and which HE IS NOT WITHDRAWING AND IS GOING TO KEEP ASKING FOR IN THAT ROOM EVERY THREE MONTHS.** Jonas Mercer said *you are right* and *there is nothing I can put next to it*, and then gave Renn the one true thing he had: **he has asked for three things and not one of them has ever been said no to, and that is the reason he has not got any of them, and it is not the reason anybody in this city would give if they were asked.** Renn said it was the first useful thing anybody had said to him in six months and that he was not going to repeat it.

**AND RENN'S OWN QUESTION IS UNANSWERED AND IS STILL THE ENGINE, AND HE TOLD JONAS MERCER ABOUT IT IN THAT ROOM, IN FRONT OF NINE PEOPLE, IN THE AFTERNOON:** in the spring he is going to put it to somebody who can answer it, and it is not going to be Jonas Mercer, and Jonas Mercer is not going to be in the room, and he is telling him then so that he cannot stand in a corridor in six months and say nobody thought he should have been there. Jonas Mercer said *that's right*. **ABOUT NINE PEOPLE CAME TO THAT MEETING AND JONAS MERCER WAS IN THE ROOM AS WELL, AND 0199 NOW CLOSES WITH THE NINE OF THEM GOING OUT INTO A STREET; AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THAT LAST LINE SAID EIGHT AND WAS WRONG. THE TWO INTERNAL DATES IN THAT ROOM WERE ALSO REPAIRED AT THE SAME TIME: RENN'S *LAST TUESDAY* POINTED AT 13 OCTOBER AND HE MEANT 6 OCTOBER, AND *CAME ON WEDNESDAY* WAS AMBIGUOUS BETWEEN 30 SEPTEMBER AND 14 OCTOBER, AND BOTH NOW CARRY THE MONTH.** **YOLANDA FOFANA IS NOT NAMED, IS NOT IN A ROOM, IS NOT TOLD ANYTHING AND IS NOT ASKED ANYTHING, AND THE PHRASE *THE NINTH* IS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS.**

**THE BATCH'S QUESTION IS RESTATED AS A FACT THAT IT IS STILL OPEN AND IT IS NOT ANSWED: A PERMISSION IS A THING A PERSON MAY DO. AN OBLIGATION IS A THING A PERSON HAS TO DO. NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS WORKED OUT WHAT EITHER OF THE MEN ON THE PERMISSION WAS HANDED. IT IS OPEN.**

## 4. THE THINGS THAT GOT WRITTEN DOWN AND THE THING THAT DID NOT

- **THE DRAWING IS ON MORE WALLS THAN IT WAS IN SEPTEMBER AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH CAN SAY HOW MANY, AND NO CHAPTER IN THIS BATCH STATES A NUMBER OF WALLS THAT WAS NOT ARRIVED AT.** Forty is the one figure and it came out of the Volume 04 close: out on the Friday morning into four places, forty walls by that night, more since. A place that has been discussed is a place that has been dismissed, and Peverell Street is busier than it was and nobody can say why.
- **ON FRIDAY 30 OCTOBER SOMEBODY WROTE ONE LINE, BADLY, ON THE BACK OF SOMETHING, WITH NO NAME ON IT, AND PUT IT IN A DRAWER.** A woman of about sixty-four called Beryl, who has worked behind a canteen hatch for six years and is on nothing, has opened that hatch on Friday afternoons for about six years for a man of about thirty-one who comes at ten to three, on her own time, with no one to ask. The correct thing is the thing he has watched happen in that room and has never told her about and she has never asked him about. **A DRAFT OF 0201 GAVE IT A NUMBER — *THE ELEVENTH TIME* HE HAD WATCHED SOMEBODY DO THIS, AND HE HAD BEEN COUNTING SINCE THE SPRING — AND BOTH HALVES OF THAT WERE CUT IN THE PROSE. *THE ELEVENTH TIME* IS A CLOSED FIGURE IN THIS ACCOUNT AND WAS USED IN THIS BLOCK AND IN `state/batch-summaries.md` AS A REASON FOR EXCUSING IT, AND A RUNNING COUNT IN JONAS MERCER'S HEAD IS THE ONE INSTRUMENT THIS BOROUGH HAS SPENT NINE MONTHS REFUSING TO BUILD, AND IT PUTS A MAN WHO HAS ASKED NOBODY A QUESTION SINCE 25 FEBRUARY IN CHARGE OF A TALLY. 0195 SAYS HE COUNTED NINE PEOPLE WITHOUT MEANING TO AND THAT NINE IS NOT A NUMBER THAT MEANS ANYTHING IN THIS BOROUGH, AND A CHAPTER MAY NOT GIVE HIM THE HABIT FOUR CHAPTERS LATER.** At about ten to four she took the back of a bread delivery docket off the pad and wrote *Fri. hatch open. till 6.* — five words, no date, no year, no hatch number, the last stroke through the printer's word underneath, and the truth is that she shut it at about half past four. **She folded it once, put it in a drawer under a canteen counter that has no lock on it and never has had one, and shut the drawer. HE SAW HER DO IT AND SHE KNEW HE SAW HER DO IT AND NEITHER OF THEM SAID A WORD AND HE IS NOT GOING TO ASK HER ABOUT IT AND HE IS NOT GOING TO TELL ANYBODY.** **THAT IS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT A CORRECT THING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS COME WITH A PIECE OF PAPER ON IT AND THE PERSON WHO PAID FOR THE PAPER WAS THE PERSON WHO DID THE THING, and no list of people who cannot be found has been built in this borough in nine months and one has not been started.** The 25 June precedent of *agreed* and a date on the back of a note is unchanged and is not touched by this.
- **ON SUNDAY 18 OCTOBER A LIST OF THREE THINGS WAS WRITTEN IN ONE WOMAN'S HAND ON A PAD SHE TOOK HOME IN A HANDBAG**, and it is the only piece of paper that came out of that room that afternoon, and it is not in a field, and nobody in this city could produce it if they were asked. Mrs Obi, about thirty-six, was not asked.
- **A DRAWING OF THE SHAPE OF THE CITY IS NOW INSIDE A HALL OFF A PARADE OF SHOPS, gummed to a wall by a woman of about forty-two who has the key to that hall and has had it for about nine years, and it is there because the ones on shutters are outside and this one is inside where the people are.**

## 5. THE EMPTY SQUARE, AND THE FIRST TIME HE SAID ANYTHING ABOUT IT

**ON SATURDAY 7 NOVEMBER AT ABOUT HALF PAST TEN IN THE MORNING, IN DAYLIGHT, IN FRONT OF ABOUT NINE PEOPLE, A WOMAN WHO HAS THE KEY TO A HALL ASKED JONAS MERCER WHICH SQUARE ON THE DRAWING IS THE EMPTY ONE AND WHAT IS SUPPOSED TO GO IN IT, BECAUSE SHE HAD BEEN ASKED FOUR TIMES THAT WEEK AND SHE IS THE ONE WHO HAS TO STAND IN THAT ROOM AND SHE IS NOT PUTTING HER NAME TO AN ANSWER SHE HAS NOT GOT.**

**HE SAID HE DOES NOT KNOW, AND THEN HE SAID THAT HE READ THAT SHEET ON THE EIGHTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER BEFORE IT WENT ON ANY WALL, THAT IT HAS BEEN EMPTY ON EVERY COPY SINCE, THAT HE HAS NOT SAID THAT TO ANYBODY UNTIL THAT MORNING, AND THAT HE IS NOT GOING TO GUESS.** **THAT IS THE FIRST TIME IN SEVEN WEEKS HE HAS SAID ANYTHING ABOUT THE SQUARE TO ANYBODY, AND HE READ IT ON 18 SEPTEMBER WHILE A COMMITTEE CLERK WAS STILL TALKING AND HAS NOT SAID SO BEFORE.** He then gave the room the two correct and useless halves: it is not a district, because it has no term in it, and it is not a seat either, because a seat on that sheet is a shape with a name over it and there is no name over this one; and the line that comes into it from the district above goes nowhere, and goes nowhere because there is nothing on the other end of it yet. *So somebody left a room.* *Somebody left a room, or somebody is going to walk into it, and I know which of those two I would rather it was, and I have not got a reason, and I am not going to give you a reason I made up at half past ten on a Saturday in a hall with the heating on.*

**NOTHING WAS RESOLVED AND THE SQUARE IS NOT FILLED AND HE WAS GIVEN NOTHING.** No department, no form, no grade, no chair, no seat, no membership, no rota row, and nobody stood up and gave him anything, because it was half past ten on a Saturday in a hall and the nine people in it had come about a class and about a warm room. **THE WORD *WARDEN* IS NOWHERE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. THE SENTENCE IS IN THE ROOM NOW AND CANNOT BE GOT BACK OUT OF IT, AND THERE IS NO WAY OF KNOWING ON ANY EVENING IN DECEMBER WHICH ROOM IT IS IN OR WHO IS IN IT. A ROOM CAN HOLD A SENTENCE AND A ROOM CANNOT HOLD A PERSON, AND THAT IS NOT A NEW LINE OF THIS ACCOUNT AND NOT A MAXIMUM: IT IS SENTENCE OF CHAPTER 0144, WHERE HE SAID IT AND THEN STOPED HALFWAY THROUGH A SENTENCE CONTAINING IT, AND IN 0203 IT NOW SITS INSIDE THE PARAGRAPH THAT CARRIES THE CONSEQUENCE INSTEAD OF STANDING ALONE ABOVE IT AS A COMMENT ON THE SCENE.**

## 6. NELL ARDENT, AND FOUR BOXES, AND BEING RIGHT

**ON SATURDAY 24 OCTOBER A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-SIX, WHO LET ASHGROVE A ROOM IN KILBURN STREET IN 2011 AND HAS HAD ABOUT NINETY POUNDS OF HIS IN A TIN SINCE APRIL, CAME TO THE OPEN COVENANTS LEGAL CLINIC WITH A QUESTION THAT HAD A PERSON'S NAME IN IT.** She is the only person in the room who was right, and her answer is that nobody can act on any part of it, including her. **The permission does not touch a tenancy: no document in either city mentions a landlord, a room, a deposit, an arrears or a sum of money, and the clause about claims is about claims arising out of work, and his money is not that. He can hand the money over and nobody can stop him and nobody will know. And if he does, two things happen: a man with money sent to him is a man with a bank, and a bank is a thing that can be looked at, and he is currently only findable because a duty clerk put a line next to his name in a list; and he will have done a thing, and there is no place in this city to write down that a landlord in Kilburn Street offered a man ninety pounds in October and was refused, or accepted, or ignored, or never got an answer. He will have done it and it will not exist.** He said *so what do I do*. *Nothing today. That is the answer.* **THERE ARE FOUR CARDBOARD BOXES ON THE TABLE UNDER THE WINDOW WITH THE WORD PARTY WRITTEN ON THEM IN MARKER PEN AND THEY HAVE BEEN EMPTY SINCE THE CLINIC OPENED, AND NOBODY ASKED HER ABOUT THE DRAWER AND THE DRAWER IS NOWHERE IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS. BEING RIGHT IS NOT A FINDING AND IT IS NOT A VICTORY AND IT IS NOT A LOSS, AND HER ARC PAYS FOR NOTHING.** Jonas Mercer was in the corridor and not in the room, and she came out and said: *the day I start telling a man what he is in a corridor is the day this room turns into something else, and it would not be a good something.*

## 7. THE ORDER, ITS STANDING, AND THE RENEWAL POINT THAT WAS NOT REACHED

**THE CENTRAL CONTINUITY ORDER IS IN FORCE, HAS BEEN FOR SIXTY-EIGHT DAYS, AND HAS NOT BEEN RENEWED, EXPIRED, RENAMED, EXTENDED, SUSPENDED, AMENDED, PUBLISHED IN FULL OR QUOTED AT LENGTH IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS. NOT ONE WORD OF ITS SEVEN CLAUSES OR PAGE TWO HAS BEEN ALTERED. **IT IS DESCRIBED IN 0199 AND 0202 AND IN NOTHING ELSE IN THE BATCH: 0199 BY RENN AND JONAS MERCER, 0202 BY A WOMAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-EIGHT WHO CALLS IT THE AUGUST DOCUMENT. AN EARLIER LINE IN THIS BLOCK AND IN `state/open-threads.md` SAID 0198, 0199 AND 0202, AND 0198 DOES NOT MENTION IT — THE ONLY OCCURRENCE OF *AUGUST* IN 0198 IS A MONTH IN A LIST OF MONTHS — AND 0202'S ONLY OTHER HIT ON *ORDER* IS THE IDIOM *IN ORDER TO BE TIDY*, WHICH IS NOT THE DOCUMENT.** IT IS NOT PUT IN ANY DOCUMENT IN THIS BATCH. ITS SIXTH CLAUSE IS STILL NOT BEING APPLIED AND IT IS STILL NOT SETTLED. THE RENEWAL POINT REMAINS WEDNESDAY 11 NOVEMBER 2015 AND IT IS ON PAGE TWO AND IT STAYS THERE, AND IT IS NOT NAMED, DATED, COUNTED DOWN OR RESOLVED IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS.** **THE ORDER WAS NOT USED AS A NEW USE OF *THERE IS NO FORM IN THIS BOROUGH*, AND THAT PHRASE IS AT ZERO IN ALL TEN CHAPTERS.**

## 1. THE ELEVENTH OF NOVEMBER, AND THE EXACT MECHANISM, AND THE FACT THAT NOBODY DID ANYTHING

**ON WEDNESDAY 11 NOVEMBER 2015 AT ABOUT NINE IN THE MORNING, ALL SEVEN CLAUSES OF THE ORDER MADE IN THIS CITY ON THURSDAY 13 AUGUST 2015 STOPPED BEING IN FORCE AT THE SAME MOMENT. NOT ONE WORD OF ITS SEVEN CLAUSES OR ITS PAGE TWO WAS ALTERED, IT WAS NOT RENEWED, NOT EXPIRED, NOT CANCELLED, NOT SUSPENDED, NOT AMENDED, NOT EXTENDED, NOT REPLACED, NOT PUBLISHED IN FULL AND NOT QUOTED AT LENGTH IN ANY OF THESE TEN CHAPTERS, IT WAS NOT RE-INSTATED, IT WAS NOT REPLACED BY SOMETHING ELSE, NOBODY PUT A NAME IN THE LINE UNDER THE DATE, THE BLANK TERM WAS NOT RENAMED, AND THE LINE IS STILL EMPTY AND HAS BEEN EMPTY SINCE 13 AUGUST 2015.**

**THE MECHANISM, AS 0205 GIVES IT IN A RECORDS ROOM AND IT IS CANON:** a clause that says an order is renewed, or is not renewed, needs a person; there is no body in this city that can require a person, and a thing that needs a person is not a thing a city can do by itself; the instrument came off what it was standing on at nine o'clock and did not come to the end of itself, because there is nothing in it that ends; somebody would have had to cancel it, and there are **two people in this city with a department over any of this**, one of whom made it and one of whom did not, and **neither of them is going to be asked to sign anything, and Jonas Mercer is not going to ask them, because asking would mean picking one of them, and there is no answer to that which is not him deciding that one of the two is the person this city ought to be frightened of.** He did not name either of them in the chapter and neither is named in any of these ten.

**THE FIELD WAS NOT EMPTIED AND NOBODY WIPED IT.** It is a working book about two inches deep on a table by the wall in a building by the water, with a column ruled in pencil — a name, the hour called, the hour home, and the thing the person was called for, nothing else — with a run of entries in one hand from the middle of August to 14 September, no line through anything, no note in the margin and no correction. **IT IS NOT A FIELD ANY MORE. IT IS A COLUMN WITH THINGS IN IT. THE LAST ENTRY IN IT IS THE FOURTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER, WHICH IS ALSO THE LAST TIME ANYBODY IN THIS CITY WAS CALLED ON BY THAT DOCUMENT, AND THE NUMBER OF NAMES IN IT IS STILL NOT GIVEN TO ANYBODY AND HAS NOT BEEN COUNTED.**

**AND THE THING NOBODY SAYS OUT LOUD, WHICH IS THE BATCH'S FIRST FINDING AND IS NOT A REPAIR AND NOT A RESOLUTION AND NOT A RELIEF:** for the fifty-four days from 18 September to 11 November 2015, the only reason Jonas Mercer had anything to do about clause six was that the order was in force to be stopped, and you can only stop something that exists, and on the morning of the eleventh it stopped being in force to be stopped. **A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-THREE WITH A BACK THAT HAS BEEN BAD SINCE THE SPRING, WHO CAME OUT ON THE EIGHTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER BECAUSE A HAND WENT ON HIM, IS NOT A MAN WHO HAS BEEN LET GO.
